description: This file defines a REST API resource class for managing products, specifically sharing products, in the Fineract platform. It handles HTTP requests such as retrieving templates, fetching individual products, listing all products, creating new products, and updating existing products. It uses JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and integrates with Fineract services for business logic execution.

classes.name: ProductsApiResource
classes.description: REST controller class providing endpoints for managing share products, including retrieval, creation, updating, and command handling.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a product template based on product type.

methods.name: retrieveProduct
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific share product by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllProducts
methods.description: Lists all share products with pagination support.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates a new share product based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Handles specific commands (like update or delete) for a given product.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates details of an existing share product.
